messages:
Ben: Morning team 1st century onboarding question: M3 MacBook Air. Kandji enrollment is stuck on 'Waiting for device check' and the UI shows 'Network authentication required (captive portal)'. I'm on hotel Wi-Fi. FileVault escrow never showed up. Need Rosetta, Homebrew, Docker; who do I ping for temp admin? @IT Oncall
Zoe: welcome! Hotel captive portals are the usual suspect. If you can tether to phone hotspot (no portal) that usually fixes it. Also share the serial if IT asks.
IT Oncall: Hi Ben 60s. Can you DM the serial number and a screenshot of the Kandji UI? Captive portal prevents DEP/ABM reachability. Two immediate options: (1) connect to unrestricted network (phone hotspot or wired), (2) we can open a short Okta elevation for local installs but enrollment still needs a network with no portal. If you can run the enroll debug, paste output: ```sudo /usr/local/bin/kandji-agent enroll --debug```
Ben: Serial is C02M4P9J8V2F. Screenshot sent to IT. Ran the debug and it's failing with: "NetworkError: captive portal detected -> HTTP 511"
IT Oncall: yep that's the captive portal. Can you try phone hotspot for a minute and re-run the enroll UI? I'll stand by. If you can't hotspot, we can schedule a quick visit to the office to plug into ethernet.
Ben: I can tether. Creating hotspot now, switching Mac to hotspot and re-running enroll.
Alex: FYI I checked ABM and device C02M4P9J8V2F is already assigned. No DEP issues. So captive portal is the only blocker. I'll prepare a 60-minute Okta temp-admin approval in case you need to install local dev tools after enrollment.
Kandji Bot: Policy 'mac-newhire-standard' pending reconcile for device C02M4P9J8V2F.
IT Oncall: once you're on hotspot accept the Okta elevation (Alex sent it), then try the UI or run `sudo /usr/local/bin/kandji-agent enroll --debug` if the UI still shows errors. For Rosetta: run `/usr/sbin/softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license`. For Homebrew/Docker allow 'Developer Tools' when macOS prompts in System Settings (Security & Privacy).
Ben: Switched to hotspot, accepted Okta temp-admin. Reran enroll UI. It proceeded past the device check and now shows 'Enrolled'. FileVault escrow prompt appeared and completed.
Helena: Welcome aboard, Ben! Glad that did it. For the YubiKey note: if escrow uses a hardware token make sure the token is inserted before the escrow dialog appears; for NFC models sometimes the prompt times out.
Ben: Installed Rosetta with the suggested command. Brew installed. Docker Desktop installed (gave permission in Privacy & Security). Everything looks green. Leaving a quick note for future new hires: hotel wifi + captive portals -> use phone hotspot or wired ethernet for initial Kandji enroll. If you need local installs request a short Okta elevation.
Zoe: nice write-up, thanks Ben. Also helpful: keep your hotspot password simple for quick connect and turn off VPN/proxy during enrollment.
Ben: Appreciate the help all 44b :tada:
